name: @srljs/core
description: Buildless reactive frontend library: signals, a template dialect checked without a compiler, routing, forms, i18n, auth and micro-frontends, plus a component collection built on it
author: Bernardo Giordano
//: This package defines the browser mounts and import prefixes in srl below.
The import map and Node bundles are derived from that table. The explicit
exports also give the CLI the small set of source modules it needs.
Run npm run package before publishing so every dist target and the shipped docs exist.
//sideEffects: Component modules register custom elements when imported. Bundlers must keep
those imports even when no exported value is used.
//files: Publish the library, components, generated bundles, shared tsconfig, and the
docs copy with its llms.txt index. Tests stay out of the tarball except for the
//customElements: The Custom Elements Manifest for the elements this package defines, written by
npm run package from the project model, for Storybook and IDE plugins.
//dependencies: Node and bundler consumers install the same pinned Lit and signals versions
that the browser import map serves from lib/vendor.
//srl: mounts maps browser URL prefixes to package directories. imports maps bare
specifiers to those directories. bundles names the generated registry
entries, and an entry module gives a bundle's name to the import map too.
vendor maps third-party specifiers to committed browser files.
